title: TaskFlow
description: An enterprise-grade productivity platform with Kanban boards, real-time collaboration via Socket.IO, JWT + Google OAuth authentication, drag-and-drop task management, and a hardened security architecture. Built with React (Vite), Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

title: Blogsify
description: A feature-rich MERN stack blogging platform featuring secure JWT authentication, rich text editing, and real-time comment capabilities. Designed with a modular architecture for scalability.

title: TrentShopNow
description: A comprehensive e-commerce solution with advanced product filtering, shopping cart functionality, and secure checkout. Built with optimal performance and user experience in mind.

title: VideoX
description: A high-performance video streaming application supporting large file uploads and adaptive playback. Leverages MongoDB GridFS for efficient media storage and retrieval.

title: ExclusiveTV
description: A premium Android application for seamless live TV streaming. Features a custom video player, D-Pad navigation support for Android TV, and real-time channel updates. Designed for a high-end viewing experience.

title: StreamPlus
description: A native Android streaming app built with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin. Features a Netflix-style content feed with horizontal rows, Firebase-backed authentication with Crashlytics reporting, Hilt dependency injection, and a fully dark OLED-optimized UI. Targets Android API 24–34.

title: PlayNox Player
description: A high-performance native Android video player powered by the MPV/libmpv media engine with hardware acceleration. Features Material Design 3 with Material You dynamic colors, AMOLED dark mode, edge swipe gestures for brightness & volume, subtitle support, real-time video enhancement (brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma), and multilingual support. Targets Android API 26–36.

title: Netflix Clone
description: A pixel-perfect recreation of the Netflix interface, integrated with the TMDB API for live movie data. Demonstrating mastery of complex CSS grids and responsive design patterns.

title: IMDB Clone
description: An interactive movie database application featuring dynamic search, detailed views, and rating systems. Optimized for fast content delivery and seamless navigation.

title: DesiDelights
description: Discover authentic Indian recipes. From spicy curries to sweet desserts, find the best traditional and modern Indian dishes. Features a rich search and filtering experience.

title: GymWala
description: A modern fitness companion app offering workout guides and health tracking. Features a sleek, high-contrast UI designed for motivation and clarity.

title: Live TV
description: A web-based TV streaming interface aggregating free-to-air channels. Features a custom video player implementation and an approachable channel guide UI.

title: Playlist Downloader
description: A web tool for managing and downloading M3U playlist files. Enables users to parse, preview, and export playlists for use across media players and IPTV applications.

title: Task Management App
description: A productivity tool for managing daily tasks with intuitive drag-and-drop organization. Built with Firebase for real-time data synchronization across devices.

title: Advanced ToDoList
description: A modern, responsive ToDoList application built with React, Node.js, and Firebase. Features real-time data synchronization, drag-and-drop organization, and a clean, intuitive interface.

title: OmenControl for Linux
description: Open-source GTK4 Linux control center for HP Omen & Victus laptops. Replaces the Windows OMEN Gaming Hub with native fan control (15-sample hysteresis), zero-overhead RGB keyboard lighting, GPU MUX switching (Hybrid/Discrete/Integrated), WMI hardware power profiles, and real-time CPU/GPU telemetry dashboards.

title: Image Gallery
description: A masonry-style image gallery with seamless upload functionality and preview modes. Optimized for handling high-resolution media with minimal latency.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This very website! A showcase of modern frontend techniques including glassmorphism, particle animations, lazy loading, and a fully responsive layout built with Next.js.

title: Logic Website
description: A static corporate website for a logistics company, focusing on clear information architecture and professional branding.

title: AI ChatBot
description: An intelligent conversational interface powered by NLP APIs. Features a clean, message-based UI that handles real-time user interactions gracefully.
